integrity: All inequalities are proved symbolically from the published norm definition. The included finite checker only reproduces the explicit witness relations and decimal evaluations; it is not used to justify the infinite tail bound.
scientific_limitations: The result brackets rather than exactly evaluates the optimal segment-sum constant; the proved upper-lower gap is below \(8.368\times10^{-24}\).
title: A near-exact bracket for the segment-sum constant in the Argyros–Motakis tree norm
